topic: Coverage cannot show which hook events each harness has installed
detail: The Coverage editor shows what each harness's hooks give spaces (from docs/internals/hooks.md), the live pinned and unpinned processes from ListSessions, and the tool-hooks layer's problem. Whether PreToolUse and CwdChanged are actually wired in ~/.claude/settings.json and ~/.codex/hooks.json is computed only by install.ToolHooks for 'orch status'. A small operator-only RPC returning that per harness would let the app mark a harness whose hooks are missing.
